How to change your MLBB nickname: price, invisible name, symbols

We change the name in the profile, sort out the card price, build a blank nickname from Unicode characters and check that the game accepts it.

In this story

  1. How to change your nickname: step by step
  2. How much a nickname change costs
  3. How to make an invisible nickname
  4. Symbols and stylish nicknames
← All news

In brief

  • You change your nickname in the profile: tap the avatar in the top-left corner, then your name.
  • On a new account the first change is free. After that you need a Rename Card.
  • The card costs diamonds. Guides quote 239 and 299 diamonds, so check the exact price in the shop.
  • A blank nickname is built from invisible Unicode characters, but the game may reject them.

Your Mobile Legends nickname is seen by teammates on the loading screen, by opponents after the match and by anyone who opens your profile. Changing it takes a couple of taps, but only once for free. Here is where the rename button is, what the card costs, how to make an invisible nickname and why a symbol from a generator may be refused.

How to change your nickname: step by step

  • In the main menu, tap your avatar in the top-left corner. Your profile opens.
  • Tap your current nickname or the pencil icon next to it.
  • Type the new name. If it has symbols, put it together in your notes first and paste it in one go.
  • Tap OK. If you have not used the free change yet, the name changes without a card.
  • If the free change is gone, the game asks for a Rename Card. A card you bought can also be used from the backpack: find it among your items and tap Use.

Rank, stars, heroes, skins and statistics stay where they were after a rename. The account is identified by Game ID and Zone ID, not by the nickname, so your friends stay too: they simply see the new name.

How much a nickname change costs

Ways to change your nickname and their price
WayPriceCondition
First changeFreeOnce per account, if you have never renamed
Rename Card from the shop239 or 299 diamonds according to guidesThe exact price is shown in the shop before you buy
Season first top-up quest50 diamondsAccording to ONE Esports: top up three times on different days

We found no official MOONTON price list. The figures come from guides by ONE Esports (May 2025) and aesthetic.name (October 2026).

English guides find the card in the shop under the Special tab: ONE Esports gives the path Shop → Preparation → Special, aesthetic.name says Shop → Special → Items. MOONTON moves shop sections around from time to time, so it is quicker to open the shop and scroll through the item tabs.

Before you buy

Settle on the nickname first and check that it is free. If the name is taken or a symbol is not supported, the game shows an error and the name stays the same. Fix the name and try again; you do not need a second card for that.

How to make an invisible nickname

A blank name is not made with spaces but with characters that look empty while the game treats them as a letter or a sign. The two Unicode characters in the table below are the usual choice.

Characters for an invisible nickname
CharacterCodeWhat it is
[ㅤ]U+3164Hangul Filler, an empty Korean letter
[⠀]U+2800Braille Pattern Blank, an empty Braille sign

Copy what is inside the square brackets. On a phone it is easier to copy the character with the brackets, paste it into your notes and delete the brackets.

  • Copy an empty character from the table.
  • Open the rename window in your profile and delete the old nickname.
  • Paste the character. If the game says the name is taken, add one or two more empty characters in a row or mix both kinds.
  • Tap OK and open your profile: the name should look empty.

There is no guarantee. The Indonesian outlet Katadata warned in November 2026 that not every blank character passes the check and that the rules can change with a game update. If one character is refused, try the other. Some players may see a box instead of an empty space.

Symbols and stylish nicknames

Besides Latin and Cyrillic letters, players often add hieroglyphs and decorative signs. Generator sites offer hundreds of options, but many of their "fonts" are made of rare Unicode characters: the game may refuse them or show boxes. One or two simple signs are the safer choice.

Signs players often put in a nickname
SignExample nickname
ツShadowツ
彡彡Shadow彡
「 」「Shadow」
★★Shadow★
丶TAG丶Shadow, a team tag before the name

Paste the finished nickname into the rename field before buying a card. If a sign does not fit, the game tells you right away.

MOONTON does not officially state how many characters a nickname can have. The aesthetic.name guide gives 4 to 16 characters and warns that some signs count as two. It also mentions a 7 days pause between renames. We have not checked this ourselves, so go by the message the game shows.

Sources: ONE Esports, aesthetic.name, Katadata
